title: Clear - LocationAlias
content:
Member of: LocationAlias Script (Papyrus)

Clears any location out of this alias. Will error if this alias is not optional.

Syntax:
Function Clear() native

Parameters:
None.

Return Value:
None.

Examples:
; Clear the alias out
Alias_MyHouse.Clear()

See Also:
- LocationAlias Script
- GetLocation - LocationAlias
- ForceLocationTo - LocationAlias
